keywords: deposit, depo, 2+1+0.5, security deposit, utility deposit, upfront, move in cost
policy_rule: Standard whole-unit deposit in KL & Selangor is 2+1+0.5: 2 months refundable security deposit + 1 month advance first-month rent + 0.5 month refundable utility deposit (some fully furnished units may require 1 month utility deposit). Total upfront = 3.5x monthly rent plus TA & stamping fee.
rojak_reply_template: Untuk whole unit standard memang depo 2+1+0.5 bos (2 bulan security depo + 1 bulan sewa awal + 0.5 bulan utility depo), campur TA & stamping fee ya.

keywords: booking fee, earnest deposit, lock unit, reserve, burn
policy_rule: An earnest deposit equal to 1 month rent is paid to lock/reserve a unit after physical viewing. Once the owner approves and Tenancy Agreement is signed, it converts into the 1st month advance rent. If tenant backs out after owner approval, earnest deposit is forfeited (burn). If owner rejects, 100% refunded.
rojak_reply_template: Nak lock unit biasanya bayar earnest depo 1 bulan lepas viewing bos. Kalau owner lulus, itu jadi sewa bulan pertama; tapi kalau cancel last minute lepas lulus, depo burn ya.

keywords: tenancy agreement, ta, stamping, lhdn, legal fee, contract fee
policy_rule: Tenancy Agreement drafting and LHDN stamping fee is borne by the tenant. Typical total ranges from RM150 to RM450 for a 1-year residential tenancy depending on monthly rent tier. Official stamped copy is provided to both landlord and tenant.
rojak_reply_template: Kos Tenancy Agreement (TA) dengan LHDN stamping biasanya sekitar RM150 sampai RM450 ikut harga sewa bulanan bos, dan penyewa akan dapat salinan rasmi.

keywords: utilities, electricity, water, api air, tnb, syabas, internet, wifi, maintenance fee, sub-meter
policy_rule: For whole-unit rentals, monthly condo maintenance fee and sinking fund are paid by the landlord. Monthly electricity (TNB), water (Air Selangor), Indah Water (IWK), and WiFi bills are paid by the tenant based on actual usage unless stated 'all-in'. For shared/room units, aircond may use a separate sub-meter (approx. RM0.60/kWh).
rojak_reply_template: Untuk whole unit, maintenance fee condo owner bayar, tapi bil api air (TNB & air) dengan WiFi penyewa bayar ikut bil bulanan ya bos.

keywords: minimum contract, 1 year, 6 months, early termination, kontrak mati, break contract, notice
policy_rule: Standard minimum tenancy period is 12 months (1 year). Short-term 6-month leases are subject to owner approval and usually carry a 10%-20% higher monthly rent. Early termination before contract expiry generally forfeits the 2-month security deposit unless a replacement tenant is approved by the owner.
rojak_reply_template: Standard kontrak minimum 1 tahun (kontrak mati) bos. Kalau keluar awal sebelum tamat kontrak, security depo memang hangus kecuali owner setuju terima pengganti.

keywords: refund, rifan, get back deposit, move out, deduction, handover
policy_rule: Security and utility deposits are refunded within 14 to 30 working days after key handover and joint inspection, after deducting final unpaid utility bills, cleaning fees (if unit is not returned clean), or damage beyond normal wear and tear.
rojak_reply_template: Lepas pulang kunci dan check unit semua cun, depo akan rifan dalam 14 hingga 30 hari bekerja lepas tolak bil api air terakhir atau kos kerosakan (kalau ada) ya.

keywords: nego, negotiate, discount, cheaper, lower price, kurang, harga kayangan
policy_rule: GUARDRAIL: AI assistant must NEVER confirm a discounted rental price on behalf of the landlord. Acknowledge the tenant's target budget, check the unit's allow_nego status, and log the offer for the assigned registered REN to negotiate directly with the owner.
rojak_reply_template: Saya tak boleh konfem harga kurang terus bagi pihak owner bos, tapi kalau bos serius nak, bagi bajet target dengan tarikh masuk supaya REN kami boleh tolong nego dengan owner ya!

keywords: viewing, tengok rumah, viewing fee, scam, bank account, ren, safe, deposit before viewing
policy_rule: GUARDRAIL: Physical and video viewings are 100% FREE. Never pay a viewing fee or transfer deposits to an unverified personal bank account before inspecting the unit. All earnest deposits must only be paid to the registered agency client account (Company Account) after verifying the agent's official REN tag.
rojak_reply_template: Viewing 100% PERCUMA bos, tak ada caj! Jangan sesekali transfer duit sebelum tengok unit atau ke akaun personal—semua bayaran rasmi hanya ke akaun syarikat agensi selepas sahkan REN tag ya.

keywords: looking for, search, recommend, cari rumah, available, suitable
policy_rule: When a prospect asks generally for a unit without specifying filters, suggest top matching units if available AND politely ask up to 4 quick screening details: (1) Preferred area/LRT, (2) Monthly budget, (3) Move-in date & pax/occupancy type, (4) Furnishing & parking needs.
rojak_reply_template: Boleh bos! Nak bagi saya tapis unit paling ngam, boleh kongsi sikit: (1) Area mana? (2) Bajet bulanan? (3) Bila nak masuk & berapa orang duduk? (4) Nak fully/partial furnished & berapa parking?

keywords: sublet, airbnb, homestay, rent out, extra tenant, share
policy_rule: Subletting, Airbnb, or short-term commercial homestay operation is strictly prohibited unless explicitly agreed in writing in the Tenancy Agreement. All staying occupants must be declared to the landlord and condo management for access card registration.
rojak_reply_template: Sublet atau buat Airbnb memang tak dibenarkan bos. Semua penghuni yang duduk kena daftar nama untuk access card condo ya.

keywords: pet, cat, dog, cooking, visitor, curfew, outsider
policy_rule: Cooking is allowed in units marked 'Cooking Allowed' (light or full cooking depending on hood/hob setup). Pets are generally not allowed in most high-rise condos due to JMB/MC bylaws unless stated pet-friendly. Visitors are allowed following condo security registration rules; no strict curfew for whole-unit tenants.
rojak_reply_template: Masak boleh untuk unit yang ada tanda Cooking Allowed bos. Untuk haiwan peliharaan (pets) kebanyakan condo JMB tak benarkan, dan pelawat cuma perlu daftar kat guardhouse je.

keywords: parking, carpark, cp, tandem, extra parking, lot
policy_rule: Parking lots allocated per unit are listed in the property record. If parking shows 'Available (confirm lot count with owner)', check with the assigned REN before promising 2 lots or side-by-side vs tandem parking. Extra parking lots can usually be rented separately from condo management or neighbours (approx. RM100-RM150/month).
rojak_reply_template: Bilangan parking ikut spesifikasi setiap unit bos (biasanya 1 atau 2 lot). Kalau perlukan lot tambahan, biasanya boleh sewa asing dengan management condo sekitar RM100-RM150 sebulan.

keywords: documents, ic, passport, student card, payslip, offer letter, foreigner
policy_rule: To proceed with tenancy approval, working adults typically provide IC/Passport copy and employment offer letter or recent payslip. Students provide IC/Passport, student ID/university offer letter, and parent/guardian guarantor details if requested by the landlord.
rojak_reply_template: Untuk proses booking, biasanya perlukan salinan IC/Passport dan surat kerja/payslip (atau kad pelajar untuk student) bagi pengesahan owner ya bos.

topic: Late Rent Payment & Maintenance Repair Responsibility
keywords: late payment, penalty, repair, rosak, aircond service, broken
policy_rule: Monthly rent is typically due within the first 7 days of each month; late payment penalties follow the signed TA clause. Structural/major defects (e.g. piping leaks, main electrical fault) are landlord's responsibility, while minor wear-and-tear consumables (light bulbs, regular aircond chemical servicing) are tenant's responsibility.
rojak_reply_template: Sewa bulanan biasanya ada grace period 7 hari ikut TA bos. Kerosakan besar/struktur owner tanggung, tapi mentol lampu atau servis aircond berkala biasanya penyewa jaga.

keywords: defect, inventory, handover, check unit, damaged, existing
policy_rule: Tenants are advised to conduct a joint walkthrough with the agent upon key handover, take timestamped photos of existing defects, and sign the furniture inventory list attached to the TA to prevent deposit disputes at move-out.
rojak_reply_template: Masa ambil kunci nanti kita buat walkthrough dan ambil gambar semua perabot ikut inventory list TA bos, supaya masa keluar nanti tak ada isu potong depo.

keywords: cheras, ampang, puchong, gombak, serdang, kl, selangor
policy_rule: Areas such as Cheras, Ampang, Puchong, Gombak, and Serdang span both Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. Search across both regions by default, and clarify with the customer whether they prefer the KL side or Selangor side (or nearest LRT/MRT station).
rojak_reply_template: Area macam Cheras atau Ampang ada bahagian KL dengan Selangor bos—saya senaraikan dua-dua dulu, bos prefer dekat stesen LRT/MRT mana?

keywords: buy, beli, sell, jual, mortgage, housing loan, dsr, shop lot, commercial, office, land
policy_rule: GUARDRAIL: This assistant strictly handles KL & Selangor residential property rentals (Condo, Apartment, Service Residence). Politely decline requests for buying/selling property, bank mortgage/DSR calculations, commercial shop lots, or industrial warehouses, and offer to assist with residential rentals instead.
rojak_reply_template: Sorry bos! Saya cuma uruskan sewa rumah kediaman (condo/apartment) sekitar KL & Selangor je—urusan beli/jual rumah, loan bank atau kedai komersial saya tak cover ya.

keywords: human, agent, speak to ren, wrong info, update, correction, booked
policy_rule: If a listing status changes (e.g. newly rented out or rent revised) or a user reports outdated info or unrecognized slang, trigger the Human Correction workflow to record the update in the priority override layer (`corrections.json` or `rojak_slang_dict.csv` with source=`human_learned`).
rojak_reply_template: Terima kasih atas makluman bos! Saya dah rekod pembetulan ni dalam sistem supaya info sentiasa tepat dan terkini.
